status: Complete exact-letter dagesh reinspection; all35 disclosed uncertainties retained
scope: All35 remaining unreadablePoint/dagesh positions in S3Y23, ESG6 and SUS6, including the S3Y closing passage and ESG translation colophon. This extra exact-letter inspection deliberately overlaps earlier word-scale reviews; it does not add35 unique positions to the85-position additions pass3 total.
method: Original embedded A2 bilevel raster pixels only. Source words were re-located in the original page and prior verified word/row context; each exact target letter was inspected in a narrow native crop with surrounding frame and15x nearest-neighbor enlargement. Initial locating offsets were corrected against source context before classification; only final verified target frames are preserved here. Detached-dot classification requires a continuous white separation from the letter on every side. A bridge, filled head, connected protrusion or noisy pinhole stays uncertain. Broad-cavity letters were also checked for reliably clear absence; none met that standard. No grayscale transformation, sharpening, OCR, grammar or another translator supplied readings. Coordinate rulers were temporary location aids outside source pixels and are not included as evidence.
